name: s01_bed_side
prompt: Same man, same face and hair. Wide cinematic 16:9 film still: he lies on his side in bed at 1 a.m., duvet pulled up, face lit blue by the phone in his hand, thumb mid-scroll, tired eyes. Tall window behind him streaming with rain, orange city lights smeared. Dark, quiet, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain, teal and amber grade.

name: s02_river_wide
prompt: Same man. Wide cinematic 16:9 night shot on a city river embankment in heavy rain: he walks toward camera in a dark wool coat with the hood of a charcoal hoodie up, white earbuds, spotless white sneakers. The lower stone path is flooded with shallow water reflecting sodium streetlights; black river and far embankment behind. 35mm, anamorphic look, film grain, Netflix documentary.

name: s03_soaked_laugh
prompt: Same man, same face. Cinematic 16:9 medium shot at night on the flooded riverside path in the rain: he has stopped and looks down at his white sneakers, soaked through, water over his ankles, and he laughs once, disbelieving and delighted. Dark wool coat, hood up, earbuds, rain on his face, streetlight rim light, 35mm, film grain.

name: s04_awake_0001
prompt: Same man, same face. Cinematic 16:9 film still: late at night he sits up against the headboard of his bed, wide awake and completely absorbed, reading on his phone, a charging cable plugged in. A small bedside clock shows 00:01. Rain on the window behind, dark room, cool phone light on his face, 35mm, film grain.

name: s05_eye
prompt: Same man. Extreme close-up of one of his grey-blue eyes, lit by the cool glow of a phone screen in a dark room, a tiny reflection of text in the eye, skin texture, eyelashes, cinematic 16:9, film grain.
